notablePrerequisites:
Mark of Sakiko and Sticky Fingers attached to the same Doctor or creature with changeling you control that has power 2 or greater and that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block the creature with Sticky Fingers and Mark of Sakiko attached.
description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko and Sticky Fingers attached.
The creature triggers four times.
Resolve the first two triggers, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the last two triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
